meta.title: WeChat Auto Reply
meta.description: Reads new messages from the WeChat window, hands them to a DSH session to answer, and can send images back. Switches, persona and allow-list live in Settings.

switches.masterDesc: Stops the vision subprocess immediately and restores the WeChat window position
switches.readOnlyDesc: Keeps recognising and advancing sessions, but never sends
switches.groupDesc: When off, group chats advance the session but stay silent
